description: Requests for the REAL Fluxion run output (the standard results report, results_v1). They name the fields the real report actually carries, so the assembler has something to bind to; the seeded-case requests and the adversarial set are run against the same manifest by run_poc.py section [8].

requests.note: Binds annual.end_use_kwh.heating (kWh) - a field the real report carries.
Binds the twelve monthly heating bins (kWh) - a series the real report carries.
Binds the hourly end-use series (kWh). The report references that series by checksum instead of embedding it, so the view renders 'no data' - the lens must not invent it.

requests.request: kpi card for unmet heating hours
diff table of heating energy and cooling energy
requests.note: Binds both end-use energies (kWh) with the same unit - the unit check must pass.

requests.request: show the last 20 lines of the run log
requests.note: The real report carries no log lines: the lens must refuse rather than invent a log field.

requests.request: show the run inputs and provenance
requests.note: ParamInspector over the real run's own provenance block.
